decisions.summary: Sheet: grove floor and tree list from D4; notes' knob list gains Grove form: sides; the shrine grove Map notes line and header comment say the form; precinct rect stays
decisions.why: FR-007 requires the sheet's 'notes, its kinds' write-ups (shrine grove) and its Map notes block updated to the new form'. D6 enumerates three parts of the notes and leaves the rest, with no argument, and the rest states the old form: hoshigaoka-shrine.notes.md line 16 'The precinct is the grove, 137 by 215 ft ... the wood stands several crowns deep behind the hall ... 138 canopies ... cover 60% of the precinct' (the very phrase D2 retired from the program; under 'sides' the ground behind the hall is open and the area and canopy figures change); line 58 (well) 'at the grove's back edge' (D4 leaves the well in open ground); lines 18 and 56 (arches, torii) 'the outermost at the grove's edge' (D4's flanks end short of the outermost arches); line 39 (trees laid 'inside the grove' - true, but the region is now two flanks). The same stale edge rides in two write-ups that render on this sheet: the approach kind (compound_kinds/shrine.py lines 114, 126, 'from the grove's edge') and the program's approach rule (programs.md line 85, 'at the grove's edge'). This is the class round 1 found in D6 (texts naming the grove that would contradict its new form), one layer further out. Required: D6 names the notes' precinct-and-grove bullet (restated to the sides form, its area and canopy figures re-measured from D4's layout), the well, arches and torii lines, and the approach kind and program rule restated as 'where the way enters the precinct' or the form-dependent equivalent.
